_about: The painkiller's pain protection covers the trap too (the owner, 2026-11-06: two traps kill unless a painkiller is active). Its damage_protection had one record, pain x 0.9 for ranged hits; the trap's two foot hits are slash (the only slash in the game data), so it took none. A second record, pain x 0.9 for slash: medkit::reduce_damage (patch 94's medical.protect) matches a record by hit type and pool, and Potent Painkiller's -0.01 a rank applies to every pain record. A trap (0.55 a foot, 0.5 of a foot's slash to pain) is 0.55 pain: two are 1.1, dead; with the painkiller 0.99 (0.957 at Potent Painkiller 3).
